g.text: Share of available project abstracts mentioning each theme. Sample sizes vary substantially across periods.
Development Priorities in the Bank's Own Words
Source: World Bank Projects & Operations List; IBRD Statement of Loans and Guarantees (DS00047, snapshot 09/30/2026). Keyword search of WB Projects API abstracts.
Grey indicates no abstracts available. Percentages use only projects with available abstracts; they do not measure project expenditure or outcomes.
